issues.description: image.tobytes() with format='RGB' corrupts non-RGB images returned by Gemini
issues.detail: Gemini may return PNG/JPEG that PIL decodes as RGBA, P, or L. Calling tobytes() without converting and then declaring format='RGB' produces a buffer whose size and channel layout do not match the declared format. Fix by calling image.convert('RGB') before tobytes(). All three reviewers flagged this as a real production bug.

The diff mutates a private underscore attribute of google-genai globally at import time, affecting every consumer in the process. The author labels it 'temporary hack.' Push it to client construction, pin the dependency, or upstream a supported API. Unanimously flagged.

issues.description: Model-capability dispatch encoded as substring checks on the model name
issues.detail: Both 'startswith("gemini-2.5-flash")' and '"image" in model_name' will misfire when Google ships future models like 'imagen' or 'gemini-X-image-understanding'. Replace with an explicit capability table or registry keyed by model id. All three reviewers identified this fragility.

issues.description: Default model bump from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash smuggled into a feature PR
issues.detail: Changing the default silently shifts latency, cost, and behavior for every caller relying on it. CHANGELOG notes it, but it belongs in its own commit so users can reason about it independently of the image-generation feature. Flagged by all three.

issues.description: No error handling around Image.open of arbitrary server-returned bytes
issues.detail: Malformed inline_data will raise UnidentifiedImageError and tear down the entire context-processing loop. Wrap decoding in try/except, log the failure, and continue processing remaining parts so one bad image does not abort the stream.

issues.description: New image-emission branch has no tests and runs a synchronous decode on the event loop
issues.detail: The new elif has neither a unit test (which would have caught the RGB/RGBA bug) nor any offload of PIL's tobytes() decode off the event loop thread. Add a test that feeds a synthetic inline_data part and asserts the OutputImageRawFrame; consider asyncio.to_thread for the decode.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the feature is small and mostly mechanical, but ships two real defects: a self-labeled 'temporary hack' that monkey-patches google-genai's private READ_BUFFER_SIZE globally at import time, and an image.tobytes() path that declares 'RGB' while accepting whatever mode PIL decoded (RGBA/P/L will corrupt). Secondary issues are substring-based model capability detection that will misfire on future model names, a silent default-model bump from 2.0-flash to 2.5-flash buried inside a feature PR, missing error handling around PIL decode of untrusted bytes, and no test coverage for the new branch. Recommended path: explicit image.convert('RGB'), move buffer config to client construction, replace substring checks with a capability table, split the default-model change into its own commit, and add one unit test.
